target_moa.text: Revefenacin is a long-acting muscarinic antagonist (anticholinergic) with similar affinity to muscarinic receptor subtypes M1 to M5; in the airways it inhibits the M3 receptor at smooth muscle leading to bronchodilation.

citations.quote: Revefenacin is a long-acting muscarinic antagonist, which is often referred to as an anticholinergic. It has similar affinity to the subtypes of muscarinic receptors M1 to M5. In the airways, it exhibits pharmacological effects through inhibition of M3 receptor at the smooth muscle leading to bronchodilation. Study 127 p-value (both doses <0.0001) is correct per StatR Table 4 (L131) columns 3-4 and OTE table (L162); replaced the ambiguous SummaryR p-value quote with the verbatim StatR p-value row and clarified '<0.0001 for both doses'.

No distinct NCT for Study 127 exists in the source docs; MedR Table 3 (doc 64e55e3d L157) and SummaryR both register replicate Studies 0126 and 0127 under the single NCT02459080, so the shared value is what the FDA documents state.
